'''Starlight Imaging''' was an inbuilt system included in [[GTU]]'s [[AV-1 power armor|AV-1]] series of [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]]. Starlight Imaging magnified available light, allowing for near perfect clarity in low-light situations. It did not work in absolute zero, and sudden light flashes could damage the suit wearer's eyes.
